acceptance_criteria: All seven declared scientific targets are independently generated from equations and printed parameters without raw/reference/author-code/author-array/source-pixel inputs.
Closed-form and ODE responses, direct and FFT matched filters, uncertainty propagation, and axion-kernel limits pass independent parity checks.
Synthetic demonstrations remain explicitly synthetic and cannot promote experimental panels to paper exact.
Fail closed until the supplemental inventory, calibration traces, 60-second sensor records, finite cell geometry, and prior-constraint tables are supplied with hashes.
When inputs exist, fit calibration decays, apply the PSD-weighted filter to every segment, aggregate all 36 datasets, integrate the finite-volume axion kernel, and preserve checkpoint/resume records.
No source image or digitized curve is accepted as a substitute for an experimental array.
All formula-level checks pass using printed quantities or explicitly declared non-paper-exact probes.
Experimental arrays and calibration inputs are hash-bound before full-panel reanalysis.
A finite formula attestation never promotes synthetic data to paper-exact scientific coverage.
